offering_description.value: Purchases defaulted consumer receivables, mainly charged-off credit card debt, at a discount from banks and other creditors. Collects on them through legal, call-center and digital channels, and also provides related servicing and portfolio management. Operates mainly through Midland Credit Management in the US and Cabot Credit Management in Europe.

primary_products.value: purchased defaulted consumer receivable portfolios; charged-off credit card debt

primary_services.value: debt collection; receivables recovery; portfolio management; debt servicing

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit card issuers and other creditors selling defaulted receivables; B2C: consumers with defaulted debt who make repayments

end_markets.value: consumer banking; consumer credit; financial services; telecommunications; utilities

revenue_model.value: other: collections on purchased receivable portfolios, recognized as revenue over time; service fees: fees for servicing and collecting receivables for third parties

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: buys defaulted receivables from creditors and recovers payments from consumers; service provider: collection and servicing of receivables

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom and Europe, plus Latin America and other markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: purchase and collection of defaulted consumer receivables

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct portfolio purchases from banks and creditors, plus direct consumer outreach; other: collection through call centers, legal channels and digital payment platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: high: debt collection regulated by the CFPB, FDCPA, FTC, state licensing and UK FCA rules
